1.1: Hakkallin shebbaddemay, hashshitin, veharimin vehauzradin, uvenot shuach, uvenot shikma, venovlot hattemara, vehaggufnin, vehannitzpa. uvihuda, haog, vehachometz shebbihuda, vehakkusbar. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hashshitin peturin, chutz mishshel dufera. kol harimin peturin, chutz merime shikmona. kol benot shikma peturot, chutz min hammustafos:
1.2: Haddemay en lo chomesh, veen lo viur, veneechol leonen, venichnas lirushalayim veyotze, umeabbedin et miuto badderachim, venotno leam haaretz, veyochal kenegdo. umechallelim oto kesef al kesef, nechoshet al nechoshet, kesef al nechoshet, unechoshet al happerot, uvilvad sheyyachazor veyifde et happerot, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, yaale happerot veyeachlu virushalayim:
1.3: Hallokeach lezera velivhema, kemach leorot, shemen lener, shemen lasuch bo et hakkelim, patur min haddemay. mikkeziv ulehallan, patur min haddemay. challat am haaretz, vehamedumma, vehallakuach bechesef maaser sheni, usheyare hammenachot, peturin min haddemay. shemen arev, bet shammay mechayyevin, uvet hillel potrin:
1.4: Haddemay, mearvin bo, umishtattefin bo, umevarchin alav, umezammenin alav, umafrishin oto arom, ben hashshemashot. ha im hikdim maaser sheni larishon, en bechach kelum. shemen shehaggardi sach beetzbeotav, chayyav biddemay. veshehassorek noten batztzemer, patur min haddemay:

2.1: Veellu devarim mitasserin demay bechol makom. haddevela, vehattemarim, vehecharuvim, haorez, vehakkammon. haorez shebbechutza laaretz, kol hammishtammesh mimmennu patur:
2.2: Hamekabbel alav lihyot neeman, measser et shehu ochel, veet shehu mocher, veet shehu lokeach, veeno mitareach etzel am haaretz. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammitareach etzel am haaretz neeman. amru lo, al atzmo eno neeman, ketzad yehe neeman al shel acherim:
2.3: Hamekabbel alav lihyot chaver, eno mocher leam haaretz lach veyavesh, veeno lokeach mimmennu lach, veeno mitarech etzel am haaretz, velo mearcho etzlo bichsuto. rabbi yehuda omer, af lo yegaddel behema dakka, velo yehe farutz bindarim uvischok, velo yehe mittamme lemetim, umeshammesh bevet hammidrash. amru lo, lo vau ellu lakkelal:
2.4: Hannachtomim, lo chiyyevu otam chachamim lehaferish ella chede terumat maaser vechalla. hachenvanim enan rashshain limkor et haddemay. kol hammashpiin bemidda gassa, rashshain limkor et haddemay. ellu hen hammashpiin bemidda gassa, kegon hassitonot umochre tevua:
2.5: Rabbi meir omer, et sheddarko lehimmaded begassa umedado vedakka, tefela dakka laggassa. et sheddarko lehimmaded bedakka umadad bagassa, tefela gassa laddakka. ezo hi midda gassa, beyavesh, sheloshet kabbin, uvelach, dinar. rabbi yose omer, salle teenim vesalle anavim vekuppot shel yarak, kol zeman shehu mochran achsara, patur:

3.1: Maachilin et haaniyyim demay, veet haachsanya demay. rabban gamliel haya maachil et poalav demay. gabbae tzedaka, bet shammay omrim, notnin et hameussar lesheeno measser, veet sheeno meussar limasser. nimtzeu chol haadam ochlin metukkan. vachachamim omrim, govin setam umechallekin setam, veharotze letakken yetakken:
3.2: Harotze lachazom ale yarak lehakel mimmassao, lo yashlich ad sheyyeasser. hallokeach yarak min hashshuk venimlach lehachazir, lo yachazir ad sheyyeasser, sheeno mechussar ella minyan. haya omed velokeach veraa toan acher yafe mimmennu, muttar lehachazir, mippene shello mashach:
3.3: Hammotze ferot badderech unetalan leachlan, venimlach lehatzenia, lo yatznia ad sheyyeasser. veim mittechilla netalan bishvil shello yovedu, patur. kol davar sheen adam rashshay lemachro demay, lo yishlach lachavero demay. rabbi yose mattir bevadday, uvilvad sheyyodiennu:
3.4: Hammolich chittim letochen kuti o letochen am haaretz, bechezkatan lammaasrot velashsheviit. letochen oved kochavim, demay. hammafkid perotav etzel hakkuti o etzel am haaretz, bechezkatan lammaasrot velashsheviit. etzel haoved kochavim, keferotav. rabbi shimon omer, demay:
3.5: Hannoten lefundakit, measser et shehu noten lah, veet shehu notel mimmenna, mippene shechashuda lachalof. amar rabbi yose, en anu acharain larammain, eno measser ella ma shehu notel mimmenna bilvad:
3.6: Hannoten lachamoto, measser et shehu noten lah, veet shehu notel mimmenna, mippene shehi chashuda lachalof et hammitkalkel. amar rabbi yehuda, rotza hi vetakkanat bittah uvosha mechatanah. mode rabbi yehuda benoten lachamoto sheviit, sheenah chashuda lehachalif lehaachil et bittah sheviit:

4.1: Hallokeach perot mimmi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot, veshachach leasseran, veshoalo veshabbat, yochal al piv. chashcha motzae shabbat, lo yochal ad sheyyeasser. lo metzao, amar lo echad sheeno neeman al hammaasrot, meussarin hen, ochel al piv. chashcha motzae shabbat, lo yochal ad sheyyeasser. terumat maaser shel demay shechazra limkomah, rabbi shimon shezuri omer, af bechol shoalo veochlo al piv:
4.2: Hammaddir et chavero sheyyochal etzlo, vehu eno maamino al hammaasrot, ochel immo bashshabbat harishona, veaf al pi sheeno maamino al hammaasrot, uvilvad sheyyomar lo meussarin hen. uveshabbat sheniyya, af al pi shennadar mimmennu hanaya, lo yochal ad sheyyeasser:
4.3: Rabbi eliezer omer, en adam tzarich likrot shem lemasar ani shel demay. vachachamim omrim, kore shem veeno tzarich lehaferish:
4.4: Mi shekkara shem litrumat maaser shel demay ulemasar ani shel vadday, lo yittelem beshabbat. veim haya chohen o ani lemudim leechol etzlo, yavou veyochlu, uvilvad sheyyodiem:
4.5: Haomer lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot, kach li mimmi shehu neeman umimmi shehu measser, eno neeman. meish peloni, hare ze neeman. halach likkach mimmennu, veamar lo lo metzativ velakachti lecha meacher shehu neeman, eno neeman:
4.6: Hannichnas leir veeno makkir adam sham, amar, mi kan neeman. mi kan measser. amar lo echad, ani, eno neeman. amar lo, ish peloni neeman, hare ze neeman. halach likkach mimmennu, amar lo, mi kan mocher yashan. amar lo, mi sheshshelachacha etzli, af al pi shehen kegomlin ze et ze, hare ellu neemanin:
4.7: Hachammarim shennichnesu leir, amar echad, shelli chadash veshel chaveri yashan, shelli eno metukkan veshel chaveri metukkan, enan neemanin. rabbi yehuda omer, neemanin:

5.1: Hallokeach min hannachtom, ketzad hu measser. notel kede terumat maaser vechalla, veomer, echad mimmea mimma sheyyesh kan, hare vetzad ze maaser, ushear maaser samuch lo, ze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser alav, vehashshear challa, umaaser sheni bitzfono o vidromo, umechullal al hammaot:
5.2: Harotze lehaferish teruma uterumat maaser keachat, notel echad mishsheloshim veshalosh ushelish, veomer, echad mimmea mimma sheyyesh kan, hare ze betzad ze chullin, vehashshear teruma al hakkol. umea chullin sheyyesh kan, hare ze betzad ze maaser, ushear maaser samuch lo, ze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser alav, vehashshear challa, umaaser sheni bitzfono o vidromo, umechullal al hammaot:
5.3: Hallokeach min hannachtom, measser min hachamma al hatztzonenet, umin hatztzonenet al hachamma, afillu mittefusin harebe, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda oser, sheani omer, chittim shel emesh hayu mishshel echad, veshel hayyom hayu mishshel acher. rabbi shimon oser bitrumat maaser, umattir bechalla:
5.4: Hallokeach min happalter, measser mikkol tefus utefus, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, meachat al hakkol. mode rabbi yehuda belokeach min hammanpol, shehu measser mikkol echad veechad:
5.5: Hallokech min heani, vechen heani shennatnu lo ferusot pat o filche devela, measser mikkol echad veechad. uvitmarim uvigrogarot, bolel venotel. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehammattana merubba, aval bizman shehammattana muetet, measser mikkol echad veechad:
5.6: Hallokeach min hassiton vechazar velakach mimmennu sheniyya, lo yeasser mizze al ze, afillu meoto hassug, afillu meoto hammin. neeman hassiton lomar, mishshel echad hem:
5.7: Hallokeach mibbaal habbayit vechazar velakach mimmennu sheniyya, measser mizze al ze, afillu mishshete kuppot, afillu mishshete ayarot. baal habbayit shehaya mocher yarak bashshuk, bizman shemmeviin lo miggannotav, measser meachat al hakkol. umiggannot acherot, measser mikkol echad veechad:
5.8: Hallokeach tevel mishshene mekomot, measser mizze al ze, af al pi sheamru, en adam rashshay limkor tevel ella letzorech:
5.9: Measserin mishshel yisrael al shel nachri, mishshel nachri al shel yisrael, mishshel yisrael al shel kutim, mishshel kutim al shel kutim. rabbi eliezer oser mishshel kutim al shel kutim:
5.10: Atzitz nakuv, hare ze kaaretz. taram mehaaretz al atzitz nakuv, meatzitz nakuv al haaretz, terumato teruma. mishsheeno nakuv al hannakuv, teruma, veyachazor veyitrom. min hannakuv al sheeno nakuv, teruma, velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha terumot umaasrot:
5.11: Taram min haddemay al haddemay, middemay al havvadday, teruma, veyachazor veyitrom. min havvadday al haddemay, teruma, velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha terumot umaasrot:

6.1: Hamekabbel sade miyyisrael, min hannachri umin hakkuti, yechallek lifnehem. hachocher sade miyyisrael, torem venoten lo. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shennatan lo meotah hassade umeoto hammin, aval im natan lo missade acheret o mimmin acher, measser venoten lo:
6.2: Hachocher sade min hannachri, measser venoten lo. rabbi yehuda omer, af hamekabbel sede avotav min hannachri, measser venoten lo:
6.3: Kohen velevi shekkibbelu sade miyyisrael, keshem shecholkin bachullin kach cholkin batteruma. rabbi eliezer omer, af hammaasrot shellahen, sheal menat ken bau:
6.4: Yisrael shekkibbel mikkohen umillevi, hammaasrot labbealim. rabbi yishmael omer, hakkartani shekkibbel sade mirushalmi, maaser sheni shel yerushalmi. vachachamim omrim, yachol hu hakkartani laalot uleachlo virushalayim:
6.5: Hamekabbel zetim leshemen, keshem shecholkin bachullin kach cholkin batteruma. rabbi yehuda omer, yisrael shekkibbel mikkohen umillevi zetim leshemen lemachatzit sachar, hammaasrot labbealim:
6.6: Bet shammay omrim, lo yimkor adam et zetav ella lechaver. bet hillel omrim, af limasser. utzenue vet hillel hayu nohagin kedivre vet shammay:
6.7: Shenayim shebbatzru et karmehem letoch gat achat, echad measser veechad sheeno measser, hameasser measser et shello, vechelko bechol makom shehu:
6.8: Shenayim shekkibbelu sade vaarisut, o sheyyarshu o shennishtattefu, yachol hu lomar, tol atta chittim shebbemakom peloni vaani chittim shebbemakom peloni, atta yayin shebbemakom peloni vaani yayin shebbemakom peloni. aval lo yomar lo, tol atta chittim vaani seorim, tol atta yayin vaani ettol shamen:
6.9: Chaver veam haaretz sheyyarshu et avihem am haaretz, yachol hu lomar lo, tol atta chittim shebbemakom peloni vaani chittim shebbemakom peloni, atta yayin shebbemakom peloni vaani yayin shebbemakom peloni. aval lo yomar lo, tol atta chittim vaani seorim, tol atta hallach vaani ettol et hayyavesh:
6.10: Ger vegoy sheyyarshu et avihem goy, yachol hu lomar, tol atta avoda zara vaani maot, atta yayin vaani ferot. veim mishshebbau lirshut hagger, asur:
6.11: Hammocher perot besureya, veamar mishshel eretz yisrael hen, chayyav leasser. meussarin hen, neeman, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. mishshelli hen, chayyav leasser, meussarin hen, neeman, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. veim yadua sheyyesh lo sade echad besureya, chayyav leasser:
6.12: Am haaretz sheamar lechaver, kach li aguddat yarak, kach li geluskan echad, lokeach setam ufatur. veim amar, shelli ze, veze shel chaveri, venitarvu, chayyav leasser, vaafillu hen mea:

7.1: Hammazmin et chavero sheyyochal etzlo, vehu eno maamino al hammaasrot, omer meerev shabbat, ma sheani atid lehaferish machar, hare hu maaser, ushear maaser samuch lo, ze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser alav, umaaser sheni bitzfono o vidromo, umechullal al hammaot:
7.2: Mazgu lo et hakkos, omer, ma sheani atid leshayyer beshule hakkos, hare hu maaser, ushear maaser samuch lo, ze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser alav, umaaser sheni befiv, umechullal al hammaot:
7.3: Poel sheeno maamin levaal habbayit, notel gerogeret achat veomer, zo vetesha habbaot achareha, asuyot maaser al tishim sheani ochel, zo asuya terumat maaser alehen, umaaser sheni baacharona, umechullal al hammaot, vechosech gerogeret echat. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo yachsoch, mippene shehu memaet melachto shel baal habbayit. rabbi yose omer lo yachsoch, mippene shehu tenay bet din:
7.4: Hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim, omer, shene luggin sheani atid lehaferish, hare hen teruma, vaasara maaser, vetisha maaser sheni. mechel veshote:
7.5: Hayu lo teenim shel tevel betoch beto, vehu bevet hammidrash o vassade, omer, shete teenim sheani atid lehaferish, hare hen teruma, veeser maaser rishon, vetesha maaser sheni. hayu demay, omer, ma sheani atid lehaferish lemachar, hare hu maaser, ushear maaser samuch lo, ze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser alav, umaaser sheni bitzfono o vidromo, umechullal al hammaot:
7.6: Hayu lefanav shete chalkalot shel tevel, veamar, maasrot zo vazo, harishona meussaret. shel zo vazo veshel zo vazo, harishona meusseret. maasrotehen maasrot kalkala vachavertah, kara shem:
7.7: Mea tevel mea chullin, notel mea veechad. mea tevel mea maaser, notel mea veechad. mea chullin metukkanim mea maaser, notel mea vaeser. mea tevel tishim maaser, tishim tevel ushemonim maaser, lo hifsid kelum. ze hakkelal, kol zeman shehattevel merubbe, lo hifsid kelum:
7.8: Mi shehayu lo eser shurot shel eser eser kadde yayin, veamar, shura hachitzona achat maaser, veen yadua ezo hi, notel shete chaviyyot lochsan. chatzi shura hachitzona achat maaser, veen yadua ezo hi, notel arba chaviyyot mearba zaviyyot. shura achat maaser, veen yadua ezo hi, notel shura achat lochsan. chatzi shura achat maaser, veen yadua ezo hi, notel shete shurot lochsan. chavit achat maaser, veen yadua ezo hi, notel mikkol chavit vechavit:
